run_rationale: None of the evaluated bond candidates satisfy the Tier-2 floor (PF ≥1.5, WR ≥50%, MDD <20%, n ≥100). The few strategies that achieve PF ≥1.5 have very low trade counts and sub-target win rates, making their statistical significance weak. Moreover, all signals are currently approximated by SMA crossovers, so the true intended logic is not yet faithfully represented. Until longer histories (≥100 trades) and a faithful signal translator are available, no edge can be confirmed.
